name: paranoidal-warp
title: Paranoidal Warp
author: FactorioParanoidal
description: The warp odyssey of the Paranoidal Space Age branch, stage 2: three warp sectors with short routes for space platforms, own skies, sun and asteroids; a warp drive that jumps the platform between the sector gates and home orbit for a warp charge; the platform hub becomes the bridge of the Axiom-7. Does nothing without Space Age.
